workflows.events:
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'extension/**'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-appearance-preview.yml'

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'extension/**'
      - '!extension/docs/**'
      - 'native-hosts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-candidate.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-certification.yml'

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'extension/**'
      - '!extension/docs/**'
      - 'native-hosts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-certification.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-candidate.yml'
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - 'extension/**'
      - '!extension/docs/**'
      - 'native-hosts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-certification.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-candidate.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'extension/**'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-d7-archive-reader.yml'

on:
  push:
    branches: ['feat/prompt-reuse-vs09-*', main]
    paths:
      - 'extension/**'
      - '!extension/docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-prompt-reuse.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'extension/**/prompt-*'
      - 'extension/adapter/chatgpt-composer.js'
      - 'extension/tests/cpv1-09-*'
      - 'extension/tests/cpv1-12-next-*'
      - 'extension/adapter/chatgpt-current-reply.js'
      - 'extension/core/next-action-detector.js'
      - 'extension/background/assist-reply-lease.js'
      - 'extension/content/assist-result.js'
      - 'extension/core/ai-usage/local-assist-session.js'
      - 'extension/core/ai-usage/historical-candidate-*'
      - 'extension/tests/nib-v4-*'
      # Canonical recovery and its shared semantic owner consume Prompt work.
      - 'extension/core/browser-native-sync/**'
      - 'extension/core/ai-usage/delta.js'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-prompt-reuse.yml'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runtime_ref:
        description: Runtime Git ref to capture
        default: main
        required: true
        type: string
      visual_states:
        description: Comma-separated frozen states (empty captures all eight)
        default: ''
        type: string
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'extension/content/prompt-surface.js'
      - 'extension/core/prompt-surface-layout.js'
      - 'extension/ui/prompt-surface.*'
      - 'extension/scripts/*prompt*convergence.mjs'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-prompt-visual.yml'
  push:
    branches: ['evidence/prompt-reuse-visual-*']
    paths: ['extension/scripts/capture-prompt-visual.mjs', 'extension/content/prompt-surface.js', 'extension/ui/prompt-surface.*', '.github/workflows/paia-prompt-visual.yml']

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'extension/ui/**'
      - 'extension/tests/**'
      - 'extension/scripts/**'
      - 'extension/package.json'
      - 'extension/package-lock.json'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-ui-refresh-development.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/paia-certification.yml'

on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['*.html', 'en/**', 'zh/**', 'assets/website/**', 'website/**', 'sitemap.xml', 'robots.txt', 'CNAME', '.github/workflows/paia-website.yml']
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['*.html', 'en/**', 'zh/**', 'assets/website/**', 'website/**', 'sitemap.xml', 'robots.txt', 'CNAME', '.github/workflows/paia-website.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      verify_live:
        description: 'Read-only exact-byte and browser verification of inputarchive.com'
        type: boolean
        default: false
